# Ahmer Institute of Technology (AIT): full technical context

> PHP 8.2/8.3 + MySQL 8 university website with five audiences: visitors, applicants, enrolled students, teachers, staff, and administrators (super admin and permission-scoped sub-admins). MIT licensed. Portfolio project; names and figures are illustrative.

## The institute (content facts used on the site)
- Location: Indus Highway, Jamshoro, Sindh 76062, Pakistan. Contact details come from environment variables.
- Intake: Spring 2027. Applications open 1 November 2026, close 15 December 2026; entry test 12 January 2027; classes begin 15 February 2027.
- Merit: entry test 50%, intermediate (HSC) 40%, matric (SSC) 10%; ties go to the higher test score.
- Eligibility: 60% in intermediate for engineering, computing and architecture; 50% for sciences, economics, English and business.
- Fees (PKR): processing 3,500 once; tuition 50,000 per semester (engineering/computing) or 42,000 (sciences/business); exam 3,500 per semester; hostel 18,000 per semester.
- Faculties: Computing & Engineering; Engineering; Civil & Architecture; Sciences & Humanities; Management Sciences. Fifteen BS programs (Architecture is five years).

## Admissions workflow
1. Applicant registers (name, father's name, email, CNIC, date of birth, phone, password) and signs in at /login.
2. Applicant submits one application per account with academic record, three ranked programs, and documents (photo, B-Form/CNIC, father's CNIC, matric and intermediate marksheets, domicile).
3. An admin with `manage_admissions` reviews documents and approves or rejects with a note.
4. Approval creates a student ID `YY` + department code + roll (for example 26BSSE007), a one-time temporary password, a challan, and enrolment in current-semester subjects.
5. The student signs in at /student-login and must replace the temporary password before anything else.

## Roles and permissions
- super_admin: everything; sign-in also needs SUPERADMIN_SECRET_KEY.
- sub_admin permissions: manage_teachers, manage_students, manage_staff, manage_subadmins, manage_departments, manage_timetable, manage_admissions, manage_content, view_reports. Optional expiry date.
- Teachers act only on subjects assigned to them (teacher_subjects).
- Staff: role_type hod (department overview), security, worker, clerical, other.

## Code map
- backend/security.php: CSRF, CSP + headers, rate limiting, lockout, captcha, password hashing and policy.
- backend/uploads.php: upload validation, ClamAV, CDR, storage keys (uploads/<folder>/<random>.<ext>).
- backend/site.php: public page registry, SEO metadata, JSON-LD, layout, page cache, contact form.
- backend/cache.php: Redis -> APCu -> request cache.
- backend/rbac.php: permissions, audit log, account codes, temporary passwords, enrolment.
- backend/env.php: env loading, ait_url(), ait_redirect().
- student/download_file.php: the only way stored files are served.
- database/schema.sql: idempotent schema, constraints, views, seed data.

## Constraints for changes
- Never trust client input for authorisation; re-read the actor from the database on every request.
- Every state-changing form needs ait_csrf_field() and ait_validate_csrf_post().
- No inline scripts or styles without the CSP nonce; no inline event handlers (use data-confirm, data-autosubmit, data-print).
- Store uploads only through ait_store_uploaded_asset(); never link to files directly.
- Keep page titles at or under 60 characters and descriptions at or under 150 (the E2E suite enforces it).
- Secrets and contact details belong in the environment, never in source.

## Running and testing
- Docker: sh bin/docker-init.sh; docker compose up -d --build --wait; php bin/create-admin.php inside the web container.
- Backend tests: docker compose exec web php tests/php/run.php
- End-to-end: cd tests/e2e; npx playwright test (58 tests, 14 personas).
